title: Traditional IRA deduction phase-out — 2026
facts: Przy workplace retirement plan, Single lub Head of Household: deduction phase-out $81,000–$91,000 modified AGI.
Przy workplace plan i Married Filing Jointly lub Qualifying Surviving Spouse: phase-out $129,000–$149,000.
Jeśli podatnik nie ma workplace plan, ale spouse ma, joint-return phase-out wynosi $242,000–$252,000.
Married Filing Separately przy odpowiednich warunkach podlega specjalnemu phase-out poniżej $10,000 modified AGI.
